reason: A read-only repository analysis plugin that compares versioned Markdown documentation with repository structure and static code indicators to detect consistency drift and suggest fixes.

summaries.zh: 这是一个只读审计插件，用于比较版本化 Markdown 文档与仓库结构及静态代码指标，检测版本、目录、计数和引用漂移并给出修复建议。
summaries.en: A read-only audit plugin that compares versioned Markdown documentation with repository structure and static code indicators to detect version, tree, count, and reference drift and suggest fixes.

capabilities: Statically analyzes Markdown documents, directory structures, references, and test markers
Produces drift findings, severity levels, evidence snippets, and repair suggestions
